ownership_rules.text: Normalize aliases before defining holes, boundaries, ownership, or R+.
L13 and L14 share vertices {8,12} and share no edge.
Under the unabsorbed C43/C47 decomposition, 8->12 belongs to the exterior, not either hole piece.
Every replacement edge must be assigned to its owning hole disk; C47 admits no cross-hole shortcut.
The inter-lobe separator {8,12} is not automatically the full outer boundary of a replacement patch.
Absorbing either guard-edge incident face changes ownership and requires recomputing boundary, aliases, contacts, and lifting premises.
Do not use the 22-face boundary walks meeting only at 12 as the deletion-hole intersection.
Do not invoke the common-tournament ordinary-extension shortcut for the two lobes solely from the global exterior edge 8->12.
Use complete positive two-terminal reachability, including possible 8->12 and 12->8 returns, with zero-length paths excluded.
For multi-piece gluing, test positive transitive closure over the union of lobe and exterior reachability relations.

repository_derived_ownership.inter_lobe_interface_kind: shared vertices only; no shared edge
